title: Ludens
tagline: a DAO engagement tool that makes community more enthusiastic by using peer learning and NFTs
description:
This project is a DAO Engagement tool by peer learning, supposed to help engage contributors of DAOs by providing questions and answers.

It enables every participant of DAO can enhance and show their potential to each other.

A lot of DAOs have different kinds of ways for how their contributions, so there are no one-size-fits-all criteria.

Plus, the users can’t find DAOs by how well can contribute in technical ways. One of the ways to find the right DAO is whether the users strongly sympathize with the mission or not. 

To clarify for the newcomers how they contribute to DAO, the easiest way is to make a single criterium for contribution across structures, organizations, and persons.  

Contributors are supposed to solve and assess their outputs with each other, then show how many skills they have. And also can visualize how well they participated in this DAO by its platform. 

It’s just a kind of DAO helping tool, not itself. The more users solve and assess issues, the more contribution point and amount of shown skillsets are reflected in its platform. In some way, these platforms are like functioning resumes of DAOs.
how_its_made:
This product is mainly using smart contracts by using Hardhat and based on Polygon. The functions minting the initial NFT and sending/receiving one are made of Polygon, and the front end is based on React, HTML, and CSS. Polygon is mainly used to reduce gas fees and easily mint the new NFTs which are used to give solvers to graders in exchange for being graded.

What is an impressed for us is just focusing on problem-solving and cutting off whole new things. That's why we're aimed at using simple protocols and smart contracts as much as we can.
